hero.ability1: Breakthrough Creation: Once During your Turn you may Search your Deck for an Attachable Minion or Relic and pay its Lifeforce cost +1 to attach it to a Minion.
hero.ability2: Selective Grafting: Once During any Turn, you may spend 1 Lifeforce to move a Minion or Relic attached to a Friendly Minion to another Friendly Minion.
hero.ability3: Emergency Reanimation: Once per Round, when one of your Minions is Destroyed, you may spend 1 Lifeforce to Draw a card. If that card costs 3 or less, you may Resurrect a Minion from your Graveyard with the same cost.
hero.ability4: Animate Fusion: Once During your Turn, you may spend 2 Lifeforce to Destroy two or more of your active Minions, Negating their Card Effects. Summon a Minion from your Deck or Graveyard costing up to their combined cost. It cannot attack this Turn.
